onboarding.welcomeText: We help you keep track of supplies and agree with your family on a plan for when things stop working. Calmly, step by step.
onboarding.householdTitle: How many of you are there?
onboarding.locationText: Where do you keep supplies? Name the places, e.g. Home or Cottage.
onboarding.meetingText: If phones stop working, your family should know where to meet. You can pin it on the map later.
onboarding.locationsPlus: More supply places are part of Plus. You can add them later.

more.remindersText: We remind you 30 and 7 days before items expire.
more.remindersPlus: Expiry reminders are part of Plus.
more.remindersDenied: Notifications are turned off in phone settings.
more.disclaimer: 72h is a preparedness aid, not an official warning system. In an emergency call 112.
more.notAffiliated: This app is not affiliated with the Czech Ministry of the Interior or the 72 hours project. Guides follow its handbook, retold in our own words.
more.kidsHelpText: Shown on the kids screen. Write what your child should do if they get lost. Clear the text to restore the default.

kids.title: For kids
kids.arrived: You are there. Wait here for your family.
kids.help: If you get lost, stay where you are and ask an adult for help, like a shop assistant or a police officer.
kids.howToCall: When you call 112, say where you are, what happened and your name. Don't hang up first. If you don't know where you are, describe what you see.
